# Lehsun

Lehsun is a 5-star rated North Indian catering business based in Ebbsfleet Valley, Kent. The website is https://lehsun.co.uk/.

## What Lehsun does

Lehsun provides fresh North Indian catering for private, family, community and business events. Common event types include birthdays, housewarmings, baby showers, family gatherings, Diwali, Holi, Christmas, Easter, anniversaries, corporate events, weddings, mandir events and Satyanarayan Katha.

Lehsun also offers a daily North Indian food menu for local collection from Ebbsfleet Valley and limited nearby delivery.

## Location and areas served

Lehsun is based at 28 Portbridge Gardens, Ebbsfleet Valley, DA10 1GG, United Kingdom.

Core catering areas include Ebbsfleet Valley, Dartford, Gravesend, Northfleet, Bexley, Orpington and nearby Kent. Location pages are available for:

- Indian catering in Ebbsfleet Valley: https://lehsun.co.uk/catering/ebbsfleet-valley
- Indian catering in Dartford: https://lehsun.co.uk/catering/dartford
- Indian catering in Gravesend: https://lehsun.co.uk/catering/gravesend

## Catering details

- Cuisine: North Indian and Indian home-style catering.
- Starting price: from GBP 11.99 per head.
- Minimum catering size: 12 guests.
- Maximum catered event experience: up to 125 guests.
- Review profile: 5-star rated on Google with 75+ Google reviews.
- Hygiene: 5-star food hygiene rating.
- Menu options: vegetarian, non-vegetarian, Jain, and no-onion/no-garlic catering are available.
- Religious and cultural event support: mandir events, Satyanarayan Katha, Jain menus and no-onion/no-garlic menus are available for catering.
- Business and larger events: corporate catering, weddings and events up to 125 guests are available.
- Food examples: Dal Makhani, Paneer Butter Masala, Delhi's Pindi Chole, Dum Aloo, Samosa Chole Chaat, Dahi Bhalle, Delhi's Butter Chicken, Kashmiri Rogan Josh, Shahi Tukda with Rabdi, Poori, Butter Naan, pulao and raita.
